description_zh: 修改已存在的巡检配置
kebab_example: aliyun rdsai modify-scheduled-task --scheduled-id 847268a4-196f-416b-aa12-bfe0c1150000 --name 'RDS巡检任务' --description '定时RDS实例巡检任务' --instance-ids rm-2ze6mk259v3220000,rm-2zef3b65430j00000 --start-time 02:00:00Z --frequency Monday --time-range 24 --report-language example-string --inspection-items example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyScheduledTask

parameters.description_en: The new name of the inspection configuration.
parameters.help_en: The new name of the inspection configuration
parameters.name: name

parameters.description_en: The new description of the inspection configuration.
parameters.help_en: The new description of the inspection configuration

parameters.description_en: The new instance IDs to associate with the task. Separate multiple IDs with a comma (,).
parameters.description_zh: 新的实例关联列表, 多个取值用英文逗号（,）隔开。
parameters.help_en: The new instance IDs to associate with the task. Separate multiple IDs with a comma (,)
parameters.help_zh: 新的实例关联列表, 多个取值用英文逗号（,）隔开

parameters.description_en: The new time to run the inspection task. The time must be in the `HH:mm:ssZ` format and in UTC.
parameters.description_zh: 新的执行巡检任务的时间。格式：HH:mm:ssZ（UTC 时间）。
parameters.help_en: The new time to run the inspection task. The time must be in the `HH:mm:ssZ` format and in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 新的执行巡检任务的时间。格式：HH:mm:ssZ（UTC 时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.description_en:
The new inspection frequency. Separate multiple values with a comma (,). The default value is DAILY. Valid values:

- DAILY: Every day

- Monday: Every Monday

- Tuesday: Every Tuesday

- Wednesday: Every Wednesday

- Thursday: Every Thursday

- Friday: Every Friday

- Saturday: Every Saturday

- Sunday: Every Sunday

### Note: `DAILY` overrides all other day-of-the-week settings. For example, if you specify `DAILY,Monday`, the system uses `DAILY` as the inspection frequency.
parameters.description_zh:
新的巡检频率，多个取值用英文逗号（,）隔开，默认为DAILY。取值：
* DAILY：每天
* Monday：周一
* Tuesday：周二
* Wednesday：周三
* Thursday：周四
* Friday：周五
* Saturday：周六
* Sunday：周日
### 注意：DAILY会覆盖周时间，例如填写DAILY,Monday后端会取DAILY作为巡检频率
